name: tiktok-ads-niche-report
description: Collects competitor ads from the TikTok Ad Library (EU/EEA, GB, CH, TR) and top ads from TikTok Creative Center (Ukraine, US and more) by niche and country, and turns them into a report: who's advertising, where the ads lead, which hooks and video formats repeat, longest-running and scaled videos, untapped angles, storyboards, TikTok-ready ad hypotheses with a test plan.
